_comment: Key findings shown on the studio overview. Statements are qualitative; every number displayed next to them is read at render time from the listed experiment records (results/registry/experiments.jsonl). 'status' uses the repository's vocabulary. Edit only with a source document.

findings.title: AeroTrack-X1 exceeds the best published CST tracker (single registered TEST pass)
findings.statement: Under the CST benchmark's official protocol and toolkit, X1 (causal_g4 detector + STE) scores far above the released CST-trained GlobalTrack; part of the gap comes from reporting absence, and an absence-neutral lead remains (FINAL_REPORT.md section 3).

findings.title: X2: three temporal seeds confirm X1 but do not improve on it
findings.statement: All three causal_g4 seeds exceed the published best; the seed mean is statistically indistinguishable from X1 (registered T-comparison CI spans zero). Seed 0 IS the X1 checkpoint.

findings.title: The temporal window causes the gain over a single-frame control (T3)
findings.statement: The same network fed a single frame (t,t,t) scores much lower on every seed; the registered paired comparison supports the temporal window.

findings.title: P1: a detection-score presence gate trades false alarms for misses
findings.statement: Raising the output gate cuts absent-frame false alarms but raises visible-frame misses almost one-for-one; cross-fitted selection keeps the gate off. Not an improvement.

findings.title: Track C: learned forecasters help on Anti-UAV, not on CST
findings.statement: Learned forecasters beat classical ones on gimbal (mean-reverting) Anti-UAV motion; on inertial CST motion the classical damped velocity remains better, so no learned forecaster replaces it for CST. Forecasting ADE / NLL are never compared with tracking mSA.

findings.status: DONE (single registered TEST pass, used up)
findings.title: CF final causal system: no detectable difference from the Track A GlobalTrack on Anti-UAV IR
findings.statement: The CF system's single registered pass is complete; on Anti-UAV IR it is not detectably different from the reproduction's GlobalTrack. Never rerun.

findings.title: Anti-UAV Protocol II IR: VAL reproduces the paper within the pre-registered 1-point band
findings.statement: Plain fine-tuning and DFSC both land within 1 mSA of the paper's VAL numbers.

findings.status: NOT REPRODUCED (TEST above the paper; cause unresolved)
findings.title: Anti-UAV TEST: the reproduction scores ABOVE the paper
findings.statement: TEST mSA is several points above the paper for both arms; absence handling and metric implementation were ruled out, the label version is plausible but untestable.

findings.title: DFSC does not improve over plain fine-tuning in this reproduction
findings.statement: Across two seeds the DFSC minus normal differences are within a few tenths of a point in both directions, unlike the paper's positive margin.

limitations.text: Large targets (> 50 px) remain weak; CST train holds only 6 large-target frames.
Absent-frame false alarms and wrong-object boxes are a large share of the remaining frame-SA loss (VAL loss audit); P1's score gate did not fix it.
jungle_18 lock-on failure is seed-specific; interpret per seed.
CST and Anti-UAV VAL share source videos / sessions with TRAIN: VAL gains are optimistic.
The reproduced tracker never reports absence (scores 0 on every absent frame under Eq. 1).
DFSC-all ablation (phaseB_dfsc_ir_ism_cross) has NO valid result (TEST evaluation incomplete).
